headline: Funding for Artfarm Park, a new park at 10 Poplar Street, and several zoning amendments.
summary: Major items include a $2,600,000 bond and $2,400,000 in Community Preservation Act funds for Artfarm Park. Other items cover zoning changes, voting terminal problems from the November 3 election, and grants for parks and fire safety.

- reported malfunctions of AutoMARK Voter Assist
- Terminals at multiple polling locations during the

November 3, 2026 election, including the circumstances surrounding the failures and what steps can be taken to prevent similar occurrences in future elections.

the city’s ownership, maintenance, and testing procedures for AutoMARK Voter Assist Terminals, including whether backup equipment is available through

the Commonwealth or whether the city should maintain additional backup equipment to ensure accessible voting

- at every polling location.

4.5. Resolution

By Councilor Clingan and Councilor Ewen-Campen

(ID # 26-1715 ) That the Commissioner of Public Works inspect the lighting along the Community Path by the staircase

- connecting the Community Path to the Somerville High

School Central Hill Campus, and repair or replace any non-functioning lights to ensure adequate lighting and pedestrian safety.

4.6. Communication By Councilor Davis

(ID # 26-1688 ) In his capacity as President, cancelling the Regular

Meeting of this Council scheduled for December 22, 2026.
